+	</brief_description>
+	<description>

+		Here is a simple example:
+		[codeblock]
+		@tool
+		extends Node
+
+		const ACTION_NAMES = ["Add", "Delete", "Modified", "Moved"]
+
+		var listener : FileWatchListener
+		var watcher : FileWatcher
+
+		# A simple function for handling file actions.
+		func _handle_file_action(watch_id: int, dir: String, filename: String, action: int, old_filename: String) -> void:
+			# Simply output the detected file actions.
+			prints("watch id: %d, dir: %s\n\tfilename: %s, action: %s, old_filename: %s" %
+				[watch_id, dir, filename, ACTION_NAMES[action - 1], old_filename])
+
+		func _enter_tree() -> void:
+			listener = FileWatchListener.new()
+			watcher = FileWatcher.new()
+			# Sets the callable used to handle file actions.
+			listener.set_file_action_handler(_handle_file_action)
+			# Adds directories to watch.
+			watcher.add_watch("res://", listener, false)
+			watcher.add_watch("a", listener)
+			# Starts watching.
+			watcher.watch()
+			watcher.add_watch("/opt/", listener, false)
